result.topic_en: Scratch calculations with pairs of linear equations in x, y, z with coefficients α, β, γ and their reciprocals, products like (x−a)(x−b), and cross-ratio-like expressions (f−a)/(e−a) etc., apparently relating parameters α, β, γ to points a, b, c, e, f.
